howItWorksModal.title: How Daily Cost Tracker Works
howItWorksModal.step1: 1. Record your daily field activities and expenses for seed, fertilizer, labour, machinery, fuel and irrigation.
howItWorksModal.step2: 2. Server automatically calculates accurate subtotals and totals in integer Sri Lankan Rupees.
howItWorksModal.step3: 3. Search, filter, and export your expense history at any time as a CSV file.

voice.title: Voice & Smart Text Expense Entry
voice.subtitle: Speak in English or Sinhala, or paste/type an expense phrase below
voice.privacyNotice: Speech is processed by your browser's speech recognition service and audio is sent to it. This application does not store your audio. Transcripts and pending expenses remain on your device until you confirm.
voice.unsupportedBrowser: Voice input is not supported in this browser. You can type or paste your expense text below and click Extract.
voice.transcriptPlaceholder: Speak or type your expenses here (e.g., '1000 on seeds, 2000 on fertilizer and 1500 on fuel' or 'යූරියා මිටි 2ක් 14000')...
voice.pendingSubtitle: Review and correct any details before saving. Nothing is saved to the database until confirmed.
voice.needsReviewWarning: Items marked 'Needs Review' (missing category or amount) must be corrected or deleted before confirming.
voice.partialFailure: Failed to save {{failedCount}} out of {{totalCount}} expenses. Please review the remaining rows and try again.
voice.errorPermissionDenied: Microphone permission was denied. Please allow microphone permissions in your browser or type your expense text below.
voice.errorNoSpeech: No speech detected. Please speak closer to your microphone or type your expense text below.
voice.errorNetwork: Speech service network error. Please check your internet connection or use manual text entry.
voice.errorUnsupportedLanguage: The selected language is not supported by your browser's speech engine. Please try typing below.
voice.errorGeneric: Voice recognition error occurred. Please try again or type your expense text below.
voice.commandsHelp: Commands you can say or type: 'Change urea to 5000', 'Remove tractor', 'How much on fertilizer?', 'What is the total?'
voice.chooserPrompt: Multiple or ambiguous rows match your command. Please choose which item to update:
voice.savedRecordNotice: Saved records can only be edited in the Daily Cost Tracker, not here.
voice.commandUnknown: Command not recognized. Type an expense phrase or command like 'Change urea to 5000' or 'Remove tractor'.
voice.duplicateWarning: An expense with the same description, amount, and date already exists in the pending list.
